clips.title: The story
paras: In the Undercity’s Magic Quarter, Josef Gregorian trains tailors of the Horde. His skill guides them toward enchanted fabrics and specialized garments.

Josef Gregorian teaches tailoring in the Undercity’s Magic Quarter, where Forsaken and their Horde allies practice the craft. Tailoring remains vital to warlocks, mages, and priests who channel raw energies through woven fibers. Gregorian teaches foundational patterns and stitches the first robes for young mages who bring him the right materials.
